task.prompt: Full body, front view, strict T-pose: both arms raised to shoulder height and stretched perfectly horizontal, forming a straight line like the letter T, legs slightly apart with a clear gap between them, whole body in frame from top of head to shoes, single character centered. Plain light grey studio background, no text, no logos. Original video game fighter: a chunky 1980s tin toy robot the size of a man, boxy chrome and red body with a chest panel of chunky buttons, dials and two cassette tape reels, a rounded bucket-shaped chrome head with a single wide black visor showing an angry face made of glowing red LED dots, two springy antennae; its arms and legs are thick flexible corrugated silver rubber hoses like vacuum cleaner tubes, big blocky feet, and oversized orange boxing gloves. Art style: over-the-top 1980s straight-to-VHS action movie parody, photorealistic live action costume photo, saturated colours, heroic and absurdly serious, soft even lighting with no cast shadows.
